issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_make_y_state(...)` (problem_statement.md lines 75-83), but the template and solution repositories define and use `make_y_state(...)` (template_repository/msd.py lines 41-49 and solution_repository/msd.py lines 95-106). This name mismatch is structural (the intended function name in the spec does not match the provided starter code and reference implementation) and will confuse students about which function they should implement and which name tests expect.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to request `make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None` (matching the template and solution), or rename the template and solution functions to `_make_y_state(...)`. Ensure any tests and task labels reference the same name so students know which function to implement.
